recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a smiling male face, rendered in a high-contrast, monochromatic red and black palette with heavy digital grain and a signature-style script in the lower corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white of the teeth acts as the primary focal point against the deep red skin tones.
The heavy black shadows define the facial structure and merge into the dark background.
The red duotone creates a sense of intensity and heat across the entire composition.
The delicate script in the bottom left provides a human, personal counterpoint to the aggressive color grade.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain or noise texture
High-contrast lighting with deep black shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and fills approximately 85% of the frame, cropped tightly at the hairline and jaw.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The mouth and teeth, being the highest value (brightest) area of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright teeth upward to the eyes, then down to the handwritten text in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, limited to the deep black corners and the areas surrounding the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep crimson red, used for midtones and highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure black, used for shadows, background, and defining facial features.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white, reserved exclusively for the teeth and glints in the eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with a crushed black point to create a gritty, low-dynamic-range look.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial capital letter is oversized and expressive
The final character is a stylized numeral with a sharp, elongated tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script against a photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, informal feel of the original lettering.
Mimics the thin, consistent line weight of the custom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme close-up portrait of a smiling man, cropped tightly. Apply a deep red duotone filter with high contrast and heavy film grain. Ensure the teeth remain bright white while the rest of the image is shades of red and black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, thin-stroke handwritten script in the bottom left corner using a bright red color that matches the midtones of the face.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic red/black/white?
Is the grain texture visible and gritty?
Is the text placed in the bottom left and rendered in a thin script?
Are the teeth the brightest point in the composition?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no blue or green pixels are present.
Check that the text is legible but small and tucked into the corner.
Verify the 'glow' effect on the red highlights isn't too soft; it should feel textured.
Confirm the crop cuts off the top of the head and the sides of the face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up + Red/Black Duotone + Heavy Grain + Bottom-Left Script Overlay
